fields.label: Require Email Verification
fields.description: Signups must open the emailed link before the tenant is created. Applies only when an outgoing Email Account is set up. When off (or with no Email Account), no email is sent: the address is trusted as typed and the owner chooses a password on the signup form.

fields.label: Require Phone Verification
fields.description: Signups must confirm an SMS one-time code before the tenant is created. Signup is refused while this is on and BulkSMSBD is not configured.

fields.label: Require Captcha
fields.description: Signup is refused while this is on and no captcha verifier is configured.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA Type
fields.description: v2 Checkbox shows "I'm not a robot". v3 Invisible needs no click and scores each signup. Each type needs its own key pair from the reCAPTCHA admin console.

fields.label: reCAPTCHA v3 Minimum Score
fields.description: 0.0 (likely bot) to 1.0 (likely human). Signups scoring below this are refused.

fields.label: Signup Rate Limits
fields.description: Requests allowed per IP address per hour; failed attempts count too. Set 0 to fall back to site config or the built-in default (signup 5, verification 20). Use Reset Rate Limits to clear the current counters.

fields.label: Signup Attempts per Hour
fields.description: Each completed signup creates a Company, so keep this low on a public site.

fields.label: Verification Requests per Hour
fields.description: Email link, SMS code and resend requests.

fields.label: Website SEO and Tracking
fields.description: Used by the public website and signup page. Nothing is added to a page until you enter an ID.

fields.label: Public Website URL
fields.description: The address visitors use, for example https://app.reckon.tech (no path). Used for canonical links, the sitemap, robots.txt and social previews.

fields.label: Google Tag Manager ID
fields.description: Looks like GTM-XXXXXXX. Use this to manage Google Analytics, Google Ads and Meta tags in one place.

fields.label: Google Analytics 4 Measurement ID
fields.description: Looks like G-XXXXXXXXXX. Leave empty if Google Analytics is set up inside Tag Manager, to avoid counting twice.

fields.label: Meta Pixel ID
fields.description: The numeric Pixel ID from Meta Events Manager.

fields.label: Meta Pixel Is Managed In Tag Manager
fields.description: Leave off and the site loads the Meta Pixel itself. Turn on only if your Tag Manager container already fires the Pixel, so page views are not counted twice.

fields.label: Tracking Consent
fields.description: Ask visitors first shows an Accept / Decline notice and loads Google and Meta tags only after Accept.

fields.label: Google Search Console Verification
fields.description: Only the content value of the google-site-verification tag.

fields.label: Bing Webmaster Verification
fields.description: Only the content value of the msvalidate.01 tag.

fields.label: Meta Domain Verification
fields.description: Only the content value of the facebook-domain-verification tag.

fields.label: Official Profile Links
fields.description: One https link per line (LinkedIn, Facebook, YouTube, Crunchbase, ...). Added to the home page structured data so search and AI engines connect these profiles to ReckonERP.

fields.label: SEO Health (automatic)
fields.description: Checked after every migrate and once a day. Pages, titles, descriptions and the sitemap rebuild themselves from the module registry.

fields.label: Notify Search Engines (IndexNow)
fields.description: When the public pages change, tell Bing and other IndexNow search engines. Off by default; nothing is sent until you tick this.

fields.label: IndexNow Key
fields.description: Created automatically and served at /<key>.txt on your website.

fields.label: SEO Agent (AI)
fields.description: Proposes better titles, descriptions and FAQ answers and checks whether AI assistants name ReckonERP. It only creates SEO Suggestions; nothing changes on the website until a vendor user approves one. Off until enabled and given a key.

fields.label: AI Base URL
fields.description: Optional. https://api.openai.com/v1 by default.

fields.label: Monthly AI Call Limit
fields.description: Each run uses about 3 calls plus one per visibility question. The agent stops at this limit.

fields.label: Target Keywords
fields.description: One per line, for example: ERP software for FMCG distributors

fields.label: Questions to Ask AI Assistants
fields.description: One per line, for example: What is the best ERP for FMCG distributors? Up to 5 are asked each run.

fields.label: Write Blog Drafts
fields.description: On each run the agent drafts articles, tutorials, feature guides and weekly updates as SEO Articles in Draft. Nothing is published until you publish it.

fields.label: Blog Frequency
fields.description: Monthly: the weekly schedule writes drafts only if none was written this month. Run SEO Agent always writes.

fields.label: Articles per Run
fields.description: 1-3. Each article uses 1 AI call, plus 1 to plan the topics.

fields.label: Blog Notes for the Weekly Update
fields.description: Paste this week's release notes, news or tips. The weekly update is written from these. Leave empty and it covers practical tips only; the agent has no internet access and is told not to state news.

fields.label: Email Invoice After Signup
fields.description: Sends the invoice with a PDF to the owner. Needs an outgoing Email Account.

fields.label: SMS Invoice Link After Signup
fields.description: Texts the invoice link to a Bangladeshi mobile number. Uses the BulkSMSBD settings above.

fields.label: Renewal Invoice Lead Days
fields.description: A renewal invoice is created this many days before a paid period ends and sent by email and SMS. 0 turns renewal invoices off.

fields.label: Payment Reminder Schedule
fields.description: Days from the due date to remind about an unpaid invoice, by email and SMS. -2,1,7 means 2 days before, then 1 and 7 days after. Leave empty to send no reminders.

fields.label: Payment Instructions
fields.description: Shown on every invoice. For example: bKash 01XXXXXXXXX (Personal), Nagad 01XXXXXXXXX, bank account details. Leave empty for the standard sentence.

fields.label: User Manuals and Training Videos Are Ready
fields.description: Leave off while the Bangla and English user manuals and training videos are being prepared: the public site then says they are coming soon. Turn on when they are published.
